entities.summary: The Imam Reza Stadium, currently known as the AQR Stadium for sponsorship reasons, is an all-seated football stadium located in Mashhad, Iran. The stadium has a seating capacity of 27,700 and is the ninth biggest stadium in Iran. It hosts some matches of the Iran national football team. The stadium completed in January 2017 and was opened on 14 March 2017 on the day of Chaharshanbe Suri.
